title: Custom Systems: Eliminate Database Locks in Wholesale Serial Number Allocation
body:
Does your wholesale distribution software freeze randomly when processing hundreds of simultaneous orders?

When an SMB or B2B distributor sells technological, pharmaceutical, or industrial products, each item requires the allocation of a unique and secure serial number at the exact moment of invoicing. Conventional databases lock table rows to guarantee uniqueness, creating massive bottlenecks, frozen checkouts, and critical financial losses while operators wait for the system to respond.

The trap of vertical server scaling

Many developers try to fix this problem by hiring more expensive cloud servers or increasing connection timeouts. However, this does not eliminate data contention; it just makes you burn more monthly budget on infrastructure while the underlying problem remains latent. A more powerful server does not fix a faulty data architecture.

Our solution: Decentralized Unique Identifier Architecture

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we redesign the core of your relational database by implementing decentralized identifier generation algorithms and high-speed asynchronous in-memory processing.

  1. Decentralized ID generation: We implement optimized structures in the database engine to issue unique series without locking entire tables.
  2. Asynchronous persistence queues: We synchronize transactions using in-memory buffers that organize data writing ultra-efficiently.
  3. Transactional index optimization: We restructure logical indexing to speed up verification queries in milliseconds.
  4. Advanced concurrency isolation: We configure optimal isolation levels to completely eradicate dreaded deadlock errors.

The Real Impact on Wholesale Operations

  • Zero system crashes: Your platform maintains consistent performance even during massive peaks of invoicing and simultaneous shipments.
  • Cloud cost reduction: By eliminating data contention, your servers operate efficiently without the need for expensive scaling plans.
  • Flawless logistics automation: Warehouse operators get their labels and serial numbers instantly, accelerating dispatch times.
